predecessors.name: Colony of New South Wales
predecessors.text: 'The southern islands of New South Wales' (Van Diemen's Land)

successors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
successors.text: Tasmania with Macquarie Island, which became a state of the Commonwealth on 1 January 1901

ledger.x: 1825: Van Diemen's Land becomes a separate colony.
1844: Norfolk Island is transferred from New South Wales to Van Diemen's Land (26 September 1844).
1856: Norfolk Island becomes its own colony, split from Tasmania (1 November 1856).
1880: Macquarie Island becomes part of Tasmania (17 June 1880).
1901: Tasmania federates (1 January 1901): 'On 1 January 1901, these colonies, excepting New Zealand (who chose not to join), became states' of the Commonwealth.

wars.name: Black Line (offensive of the Black War)
wars.outcome: 'In 1830 Lieutenant-Governor Arthur attempted to end the "Black War" through a massive offensive'; the frontier war in Van Diemen's Land followed settlement from the mid-1820s.

certainty.note: An island colony: the border is the coast.
